meta.title: Budget category Balance Amount is auto-calculated as Allocated minus Spent

args.goal: On the Budget Creation page's Budget Category List tab, click '+ New', enter Category Name, Budget Allocated 100000, and Budget Spent 25000; verify that Balance Amount is auto-calculated as 75000 without typing into it, and stop with the form showing the calculated balance

steps.note: Performs the budget-category form interaction and verifies the automatic calculation on screen.
Asserts that the calculated Balance Amount displays 75000.
